technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (Hull, AO, CMF) show bullish crossovers with rising volume, but intermediate/long-term structure remains bearish (below 50/200 MAs, Ichimoku cloud), creating conflicting timeframe signals and moderate swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: CMI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 85 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional activity and news data limit conviction; market sentiment heavily bearish (52.9%) with neutral AAII signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (448), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising dollar pressures multinationals, and imminent CPI event adds volatility risk despite distant earnings (85 days).

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum crossovers (Hull flip, AO, CMF) with rising OBV and Supertrend bullish signal early swing entry potential in extreme fear sentiment (14/100 contrarian opportunity).
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate/long-term structure remains deeply bearish (price below 50/200 MAs, Ichimoku below cloud, EMA 20/50/50/200 all bearish), macro environment in crisis (VIX 448, flat yield curve, rising DXY), zero fundamental conviction, and no triggered strategies eliminate conviction for entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum crossovers (Hull, AO, CMF) offer early swing signal, but intermediate/long-term structure remains deeply bearish with price below both 50/200 MAs and Ichimoku cloud, eliminating conviction for entry in crisis macro environment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX in crisis territory (448) combined with flat yield curve recession signal and rising DXY headwinds create severe macro headwinds that override short-term technical momentum; earnings in 85 days adds sizing constraint.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical momentum insufficient to overcome fundamental weakness, sentiment extremity, and macro crisis conditions
decision.portfolio_note: Already 18 positions in Industrials sector (15% of portfolio); sector concentration and zero fundamental/smart money conviction argue against adding CMI exposure.
